mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_conversations WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversations (user_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_conversations WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, tool_calls, tool_result, created_at FROM agent_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC

mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversations SET title = #{title}, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = #{id}
